description: Up to 10 years of quarterly cash and cash equivalents for a company, as reported in its SEC XBRL financial statements (data.sec.gov). Returns `history`: one point per period end {periodEnd, usd, formType, isAnnual}, oldest first. When a 10-K and a 10-Q report the same date, the annual figure is kept. Works for any company that files XBRL financials with the SEC. Only figures reported in US dollars are included, so a filer that reports in another currency returns an empty history: an empty history means not measured, never zero cash.
name: get_cash_history

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key of the filer

formType.description: Form the figure was read from, e.g. 10-K, 10-Q

isAnnual.description: True when the figure comes from an annual report

usd.description: Cash and cash equivalents at period end, in US dollars

title: Get 10-Year Cash History
